<!doctype html>
<html lang="ko">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>옆커폰 창업 가이드북 | 결과로 증명하는 대한민국 1등 휴대폰 프랜차이즈</title>
<meta name="description" content="검증된 700+호점, 데이터 기반 수익 공식, 가맹비·교육비 파격 할인. 하루 2~3건 상담으로 월 최대 5,000만 원 매출까지. 옆커폰 창업 가이드북에서 확인하세요.">

<!-- Open Graph (카카오톡, 페이스북) -->
<meta property="og:type" content="website">
<meta property="og:site_name" content="옆커폰">

<meta property="og:description" content="결과로 증명하는 대한민국 1등 휴대폰 프랜차이즈. 하루 2~3건 상담으로 만드는 수익 공식, 지금 확인하세요.">

<meta property="og:locale" content="ko_KR">

<!-- Twitter Card -->
<meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image">
<meta name="twitter:title" content="옆커폰 창업 가이드북">
<meta name="twitter:description" content="결과로 증명하는 대한민국 1등 휴대폰 프랜차이즈. 검증된 700+호점, 파격 창업 지원.">
<meta name="twitter:image" content="assets/og-thumbnail.png">

<!-- Favicon -->
<link rel="icon" type="image/png" href="data:image/png;base64,">
<link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="data:image/png;base64,">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Gowun+Dodum&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
@import url('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/orioncactus/pretendard@v1.3.9/dist/web/variable/pretendardvariable-dynamic-subset.min.css');

:root {
  --primary: #6034A7;
  --primary-light: #A08BD0;
  --deep: #533B7B;
  --pink: #D86C9E;
  --ink: #1B1233;
  --paper: #FFFFFF;
  --soft: #F4EEFA;
  --line: #E7DCF4;
  --grad: linear-gradient(135deg, #6034A7 0%, #B392C2 100%);
}

*, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
html, body { width: 100%; overflow-x: hidden; }

body {
  background: #EAE3F5;
  font-family: 'Pretendard Variable', Pretendard, -apple-system, sans-serif;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  min-height: 100vh;
}

/* ── Layout ── */
.page {
  width: 100%;
  padding: 0 0 48px;
}

.card {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.26);
  margin-bottom: 3px;
}

.card-body { padding: 20px 16px; }


/* ── Section title ── */
.section-title {
  font-size: 24px;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--ink);
  line-height: 1.3;
  letter-spacing: -0.03em;
  margin-bottom: 18px;
}
.section-title .hl, .section-title .pk { color: var(--primary); }

/* ── Kicker strip ── */
.kicker-strip {
  background: var(--soft);
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 13px 15px;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--primary);
  margin-top: 16px;
  line-height: 1.55;
}
.kicker-strip strong { color: var(--ink); }

/* ════════════════════════════════════════
   HERO CARD
════════════════════════════════════════ */
.card-hero {
  background:
    radial-gradient(500px 320px at 100% 0%, rgba(160,139,208,.38), transparent 60%),
    radial-gradient(360px 260px at 0% 110%, rgba(216,108,158,.18), transparent 60%);
}

.hero-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 18px 16px 0;
}
.hero-logo { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; }
.hero-logo img { width: 32px; height: auto; }
.hero-logo .wordmark {
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--primary);
}
.hero-badge {
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.2em;
  color: var(--primary);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
}
.hero-badge .dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--pink); }

.hero-body {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 14px;
  padding: 18px 16px 14px;
}
.hero-text { flex: 1; }
.hero-slogan {
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.32em;
  color: var(--primary);
  margin-bottom: 9px;
}
.hero-title {
  font-size: 26px;
  font-weight: 800;
  margin-top: 28px;
  line-height: 1.2;
  letter-spacing: -0.035em;
  color: var(--ink);
}
.hero-title em { font-style: normal; color: var(--primary); }
.hero-sub {
  font-size: 13px;
  line-height: 1.6;
  color: #4b3b6a;
  font-weight: 500;
  margin-top: 11px;
}
.hero-mascot {
  width: 110px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  position: relative;
}
.hero-mascot::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 8px;
  background: var(--grad);
  border-radius: 60% 40% 55% 45% / 55% 60% 40% 45%;
  opacity: .18;
}
.hero-mascot img { width: 100%; height: auto; position: relative; }

/* ── Hero footer ── */
.hero-foot {
  padding: 0 16px 22px;
  text-align: center;
}
.hf-divider {
  height: 1px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(160,139,208,.35), transparent);
  margin-bottom: 14px;
}
.hf-msg {
  font-size: 13px;
  color: #7a6a97;
  font-weight: 500;
  line-height: 1.65;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
}
.hf-msg strong {
  color: var(--primary);
  font-weight: 700;
}
.hf-dot {
  display: inline-block;
  width: 5px; height: 5px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--pink);
  margin: 0 6px 1px;
  vertical-align: middle;
  opacity: 0.7;
}

/* ── KPI grid ── */
.kpi-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  gap: 9px;
  padding: 0 16px 22px;
}

.kpi {
  border-radius: 16px;
  padding: 14px 16px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  text-align: left;
  background: var(--paper);
  border: 2px solid var(--line);
  text-align: center;
}
.kpi.filled {
  background: var(--grad);
  color: #fff;
  border-color: transparent;
}
.kpi .kpi-text { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
.kpi .kpi-icon {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  width: 58px; height: 58px;
  border-radius: 18px;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  font-size: 30px;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,.16);
  border: 1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.38);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.55),
    0 4px 14px -4px rgba(0,0,0,.16);
}
.kpi:not(.filled) .kpi-icon {
  background: linear-gradient(150deg, #ffffff 0%, #ecdff8 100%);
  border: 1.5px solid rgba(160,139,208,.28);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 #fff,
    0 8px 22px -6px rgba(96,52,167,.24),
    0 2px 6px -2px rgba(96,52,167,.10);
}

/* ── KPI 아이콘 등장 애니메이션 ── */
.kpi-icon {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: scale(0.55) translateY(10px);
  transition: opacity 0.4s ease,
              transform 0.55s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1);
}
.kpi-icon.icon-in {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: scale(1) translateY(0);
}
.kpi .label { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4; }
.kpi.filled .label { color: #EADEFB; }
.kpi .value {
  font-size: 24px;
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1;
  color: var(--primary);
  margin-top: 7px;
  letter-spacing: -0.03em;
}
.kpi.filled .value { color: #fff; }
.kpi .value .unit { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; margin-left: 2px; }
.kpi .note { font-size: 11px; color: #6c5a8c; margin-top: 5px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.4; }
.kpi.filled .note { color: #EADEFB; }
.kpi .sub-headline { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--deep); margin-top: 8px; line-height: 1.4; }
.kpi .bullets { font-size: 11px; color: #6c5a8c; margin-top: 6px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.85; }

/* ════════════════════════════════════════
   CHAPTER 01 — COST
════════════════════════════════════════ */
.compare-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  gap: 9px;
  margin-bottom: 14px;
}
@media (min-width: 420px) {
  .compare-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }
}

.compare {
  border-radius: 14px;
  background: #F7F3FD;
  padding: 14px 15px;
  border: 2px solid transparent;
}
.compare.highlight {
  background: var(--grad);
  color: #fff;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 24px -10px rgba(96,52,167,.5);
}
.compare .biz { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--deep); }
.compare.highlight .biz { color: #fff; }
.compare .amt { font-size: 26px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--ink); margin-top: 5px; letter-spacing: -0.02em; }
.compare.highlight .amt { color: #fff; }
.compare .amt .u { font-size: 19px; font-weight: 800; margin-left: 4px; letter-spacing: -0.01em; }
.compare ul { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 9px 0 0; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.75; color: #5a4780; }
.compare.highlight ul { color: #F0E6FB; }
.compare li { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; }
.compare li .icn {
  width: 16px; height: 16px; border-radius: 50%;
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  font-size: 10px; font-weight: 800;
  background: #F0E0EC; color: var(--pink); flex-shrink: 0;
}
.compare li.ok .icn { background: #E4D8F5; color: var(--primary); }
.compare.highlight li .icn { background: rgba(255,255,255,.2); color: #fff; }

/* ── Trend Chart (Ch.01) ── */
.trend-chart {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #faf6ff 0%, #f4ebff 100%);
  border-radius: 16px;
  padding: 18px 4px 14px;
  margin-bottom: 14px;
  border: 2px solid var(--line);
}
.trend-caption {
  font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; color: #8b7aab;
  text-align: center; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.02em;
}
.trend-path {
  stroke-dasharray: 600;
  stroke-dashoffset: 600;
}
.trend-area { opacity: 0; }
.trend-pt { opacity: 0; }
.trend-chart.is-visible .trend-path { animation: trendDraw 2.2s ease-out forwards; }
.trend-chart.is-visible .trend-area { animation: trendFade 1.8s ease-out 0.9s forwards; }
.trend-chart.is-visible .trend-pt { animation: trendFade 0.6s ease-out forwards; }
.trend-chart.is-visible .trend-pt[data-i="0"] { animation-delay: 0.6s; }
.trend-chart.is-visible .trend-pt[data-i="1"] { animation-delay: 1.4s; }
.trend-chart.is-visible .trend-pt[data-i="2"] { animation-delay: 2.2s; }
@keyframes trendDraw { to { stroke-dashoffset: 0; } }
@keyframes trendFade { to { opacity: 1; } }

/* ── 옆커폰 강조 애니메이션 ── */
.trend-chart.is-visible .trend-pt-hi { animation: none; opacity: 1; }

.trend-ripple { opacity: 0; }
@keyframes yeopRippleOut {
  0%   { r: 14; opacity: 0.65; stroke-width: 2.5; }
  100% { r: 40; opacity: 0;    stroke-width: 0.5; }
}
.trend-chart.is-visible .trend-ripple-1 { animation: yeopRippleOut 2s ease-out 3.2s infinite; }
.trend-chart.is-visible .trend-ripple-2 { animation: yeopRippleOut 2s ease-out 3.9s infinite; }

.trend-hi-dot {
  opacity: 0;
  transform-box: fill-box;
  transform-origin: center center;
}
@keyframes yeopDotBounce {
  0%   { transform: scale(0);    opacity: 0; }
  55%  { transform: scale(1.5);  opacity: 1; }
  75%  { transform: scale(0.85); opacity: 1; }
  90%  { transform: scale(1.1);  opacity: 1; }
  100% { transform: scale(1);    opacity: 1; }
}
.trend-chart.is-visible .trend-hi-dot {
  animation: yeopDotBounce 0.85s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1) 2.4s forwards;
}

.trend-hi-text,
.trend-hi-text-name {
  opacity: 0;
  transform-box: fill-box;
  transform-origin: center center;
}
@keyframes yeopTextPop {
  0%   { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.3); }
  65%  { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1.18); }
  100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
}
.trend-chart.is-visible .trend-hi-text {
  animation:
    yeopTextPop 0.65s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1) 2.7s  forwards,
    headShake   1s    ease-in-out                   3.5s;
}
.trend-chart.is-visible .trend-hi-text-name {
  animation:
    yeopTextPop 0.65s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1) 2.95s forwards,
    headShake   1s    ease-in-out                   4.3s;
}

/* ── 요식업·편의점 취소선 ── */
.strike-line {
  stroke-dasharray: 42;
  stroke-dashoffset: 42;
}
@keyframes strikeThrough { to { stroke-dashoffset: 0; } }
.trend-chart.is-visible .strike-0 { animation: strikeThrough 0.35s ease-out 3.3s forwards; }
.trend-chart.is-visible .strike-1 { animation: strikeThrough 0.35s ease-out 3.7s forwards; }

/* ── 옆커폰 밑줄 ── */
.yeop-underline {
  stroke-dasharray: 42;
  stroke-dashoffset: 42;
}
@keyframes underlineDraw { to { stroke-dashoffset: 0; } }
.trend-chart.is-visible .yeop-underline { animation: underlineDraw 0.4s ease-out 3.9s forwards; }

/* ── headShake (Animate.css 스타일) ── */
@keyframes headShake {
  0%    { transform: translateX(0); }
  6.5%  { transform: translateX(-6px) rotateY(-9deg); }
  18.5% { transform: translateX(5px)  rotateY(7deg); }
  31.5% { transform: translateX(-3px) rotateY(-5deg); }
  43.5% { transform: translateX(2px)  rotateY(3deg); }
  50%   { transform: translateX(0); }
}

.trend-points {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  margin-bottom: 14px;
}
.tp-item {
  background: #fff;
  border: 2px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 12px 14px;
}
.tp-item.tp-hi {
  background: var(--grad);
  color: #fff;
  border-color: transparent;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 18px -10px rgba(96,52,167,.5);
}
.tp-item .tp-biz {
  font-size: 13px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--deep);
  margin-bottom: 7px; letter-spacing: -0.01em;
}
.tp-item.tp-hi .tp-biz { color: #fff; }
.tp-item ul { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.85; color: #5a4780; font-weight: 600; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; }
.tp-item.tp-hi ul { color: #F0E6FB; }
.tp-item li { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 6px; }
.tp-icn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 16px; height: 16px; border-radius: 50%; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 900; flex-shrink: 0; }
.tp-icn.neg { background: #fde2e8; color: #c83a5a; }
.tp-icn.pos { background: rgba(255,255,255,.25); color: #fff; border: 1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.6); }
.tp-item { margin-bottom: 8px; }
.tp-item:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }

/* ── 카드 스크롤 양방향 트랜지션 ── */
.tp-item {
  overflow: hidden;
  transition: height 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1),
              opacity 0.4s ease,
              transform 0.4s ease,
              padding 0.5s ease,
              border-width 0.4s ease,
              margin 0.4s ease;
}
.tp-item.tp-collapsed {
  height: 0 !important;
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(-8px);
  padding: 0 !important;
  border-width: 0 !important;
  margin-bottom: 0 !important;
}
.tp-item.tp-hi { transition: box-shadow 0.5s ease; }
.tp-item.tp-hi.tp-expanded {
  box-shadow: 0 16px 34px -8px rgba(96,52,167,.7);
}

/* ── Cost Chart ── */
.cost-chart {
  background: #F7F3FD;
  border-radius: 16px;
  padding: 18px 16px 14px;
  margin-bottom: 14px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 14px;
}
.cc-head {
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  color: var(--primary);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  margin-bottom: -2px;
}
.cc-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
}
.cc-label {
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #7a6a97;
  width: 44px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.cc-bar-wrap {
  flex: 1;
  height: 30px;
  background: #EAE0F8;
  border-radius: 9px;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.cc-bar {
  height: 100%;
  width: 0;
  border-radius: 9px;
  transition: width 1.1s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1);
}
.cc-bad  { background: #C2AEE0; }
.cc-mid  { background: #A892CE; }
.cc-good { background: var(--grad); box-shadow: 0 4px 14px -6px rgba(96,52,167,.55); }
.cc-val {
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--ink);
  min-width: 68px;
  text-align: right;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.cc-val .cc-u {
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: #9385b1;
  margin-left: 1px;
}
.cc-highlight .cc-label { color: var(--primary); font-weight: 800; }
.cc-highlight .cc-val   { color: var(--primary); }
.cc-highlight .cc-val .cc-u { color: var(--primary-light); }
.cc-foot {
  font-size: 10px;
  color: #a294bd;
  font-weight: 500;
  margin-top: -4px;
}

/* ════════════════════════════════════════
   CHAPTER 02 — PROFIT
════════════════════════════════════════ */
.donut-section {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 14px;
  margin-bottom: 14px;
}
.donut-wrap { position: relative; flex-shrink: 0; }
.donut-wrap svg { width: 130px; height: 130px; display: block; }
.donut-center {
  position: absolute; inset: 0;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center; justify-content: center; text-align: center;
}
.donut-center .lbl { font-size: 9px; color: #7a6a97; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.04em; }
.donut-center .big { font-size: 17px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--primary); letter-spacing: -0.02em; line-height: 1.1; }
.donut-center .sub { font-size: 9px; color: #8b7aab; margin-top: 1px; }

.legend { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 7px; flex: 1; }
.legend .row {
  display: flex; align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px;
  padding: 7px 10px;
  background: #fff; border: 2px solid var(--line); border-radius: 10px;
}
.legend .left { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; }
.legend .sw { width: 11px; height: 11px; border-radius: 4px; flex-shrink: 0; }
.legend .name { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--deep); }
.legend .desc { font-size: 10px; color: #7a6a97; font-weight: 500; margin-top: 1px; }
.legend .pct { font-size: 17px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--primary); letter-spacing: -0.02em; flex-shrink: 0; }

/* ── 도넛차트 스크롤 연동 fade-in ── */
.trend-donut {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(14px);
  transition: opacity 0.55s ease, transform 0.55s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1);
  margin-bottom: 14px;
}
.trend-donut.donut-visible {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: translateY(0);
}

.rev-range {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.15fr 1fr;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}
.rev { border-radius: 13px; padding: 12px 11px; background: #fff; border: 2px solid var(--line); text-align: center; }
.rev.hero {
  background: var(--grad); color: #fff; border-color: transparent;
  transform: translateY(-5px);
  box-shadow: 0 10px 22px -10px rgba(96,52,167,.5);
}
.rev .t { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; color: #7a6a97; }
.rev.hero .t { color: #EADEFB; }
.rev .v { font-size: 20px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--primary); letter-spacing: -0.02em; margin-top: 4px; line-height: 1; }
.rev.hero .v { color: #fff; font-size: 24px; }
.rev .v .u { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; margin-left: 2px; }
.rev .note { font-size: 10px; color: #9385b1; margin-top: 3px; }
.rev.hero .note { color: #EADEFB; }

.support-card {
  background: var(--soft); border: 2px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 14px; padding: 10px 13px; margin-bottom: 10px;
  text-align: center;
}
.support-card .tag { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--pink); letter-spacing: 0.1em; }
.support-card .sup-headline { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--deep); margin-top: 3px; line-height: 1.4; }
.support-card .sup-headline strong { color: var(--primary); }
.support-card .sup-stats {
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px;
  background: #fff; border: 2px solid var(--line); border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 7px 11px; margin-top: 7px;
}
.support-card .sup-stat .sl { font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700; color: #8b7aab; }
.support-card .sup-stat .sv { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--deep); line-height: 1; margin-top: 2px; letter-spacing: -0.02em; }
.support-card .sup-stat .sv .su { font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700; margin-left: 2px; color: #8b7aab; }
.support-card .sup-stat.hi .sv { color: var(--primary); }
.support-card .sup-divider { width: 1px; height: 22px; background: var(--line); }

.support-strip {
  background: var(--grad); color: #fff;
  border-radius: 16px; padding: 22px 18px;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px;
  text-align: center;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
  box-shadow: 0 12px 28px -10px rgba(96,52,167,.6);
}
.support-strip .ss-eyebrow { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.2em; color: #F0DEEA; }
.support-strip .ss-title { font-size: 20px; font-weight: 800; margin-top: 4px; line-height: 1.3; }
.support-strip .ss-right { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 8px; flex-shrink: 0; }
.support-strip .ss-badge {
  font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,.22); padding: 5px 14px; border-radius: 999px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.45);
}
.support-strip .ss-badge strong { color: #FFE9F4; }
.support-strip .ss-price { font-size: 38px; font-weight: 900; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -0.03em; text-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.15); }
.support-strip .ss-price .sp-u { font-size: 20px; font-weight: 800; margin-left: 4px; }
.support-strip .ss-price .sp-t { display: block; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; margin-top: 6px; color: #F0DEEA; letter-spacing: 0.02em; }

@keyframes ssCountBounce {
  0%   { transform: scale(1); }
  35%  { transform: scale(1.28); }
  60%  { transform: scale(0.88); }
  80%  { transform: scale(1.1); }
  100% { transform: scale(1); }
}
.ss-price.count-bounce {
  animation: ssCountBounce 0.65s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1) forwards;
}

/* ════════════════════════════════════════
   CHAPTER 03 — MARKETING
════════════════════════════════════════ */
.case {
  border-radius: 14px; overflow: hidden; background: #fff;
  border: 2px solid var(--line); text-decoration: none; color: inherit;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; margin-bottom: 10px;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 16px -8px rgba(96,52,167,.22);
  -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
  transition: transform 0.32s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1),
              box-shadow 0.32s ease,
              border-color 0.32s ease;
}
.case:hover {
  transform: translateY(-6px);
  box-shadow: 0 18px 40px -10px rgba(96,52,167,.42);
  border-color: var(--primary-light);
}
.case:last-of-type { margin-bottom: 0; }
.case .thumb {
  height: 170px; background: var(--grad);
  background-size: cover; background-position: center;
  position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1);
}
.case:hover .thumb {
  transform: scale(1.04);
}
.case .thumb::after {
  content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(0,0,0,0) 30%, rgba(0,0,0,.55) 100%);
}
.case .thumb .play {
  position: absolute; z-index: 2;
  width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 50%;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,.95);
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  color: var(--primary); font-size: 16px;
  transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1),
              background 0.25s ease,
              color 0.25s ease;
}
.case:hover .thumb .play {
  transform: scale(1.28);
  background: var(--primary);
  color: #fff;
}
.case .thumb .chip {
  position: absolute; bottom: 10px; left: 10px; z-index: 2;
  background: rgba(0,0,0,.55); color: #fff;
  font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600;
  padding: 4px 9px; border-radius: 6px;
}
.case .body {
  padding: 13px 15px;
  transition: background 0.28s ease;
}
.case:hover .body { background: var(--soft); }
.case .name { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--deep); line-height: 1.45; }

/* ════════════════════════════════════════
   CHAPTER 04 — START
════════════════════════════════════════ */
.steps-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 9px;
  margin-bottom: 14px;
}
@media (min-width: 480px) {
  .steps-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }
}

.step {
  background: #fff; border: 2px solid var(--line); border-radius: 13px;
  padding: 13px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px;
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(18px);
  transition: opacity 0.35s ease, transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1);
}
.step.step-in {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: translateY(0);
}
.step.step-in .n {
  animation: badge-pop 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1) 0.12s both;
}
@keyframes badge-pop {
  from { transform: scale(0.5); opacity: 0.3; }
  to   { transform: scale(1);   opacity: 1; }
}
.step .n {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  width: 30px; height: 30px; border-radius: 8px;
  background: var(--grad); color: #fff; font-weight: 800; font-size: 13px;
}
.step.highlight { background: var(--grad); color: #fff; border-color: transparent; }
.step.highlight .n { background: rgba(255,255,255,.22); }
.step .nm { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--deep); line-height: 1.3; }
.step.highlight .nm { color: #fff; }
.step .ds { font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.5; color: #7a6a97; font-weight: 500; }
.step.highlight .ds { color: #EADEFB; }

.cta-box {
  background: var(--grad); color: #fff;
  padding: 16px 18px; border-radius: 18px;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px;
  flex: 1; min-width: 0;
}
.cta-box .t { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; color: #EADEFB; letter-spacing: 0.04em; }
.cta-box .phone { font-size: 24px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.02em; line-height: 1; margin-top: 4px; }
.cta-box .hours { font-size: 11px; color: #EADEFB; margin-top: 5px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.5; }
.cta-box .icon { font-size: 30px; opacity: .9; flex-shrink: 0; }

.cta-link {
  background: #fff; color: var(--primary);
  border: 2px solid var(--primary);
  border-radius: 18px;
  padding: 14px 14px;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  gap: 4px;
  text-decoration: none;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  width: 110px;
  text-align: center;
  transition: background .15s, color .15s;
  box-shadow: 0 6px 16px -8px rgba(96,52,167,.35);
}
.cta-link:hover { background: var(--primary); color: #fff; }
.cta-link .cl-icon { font-size: 22px; line-height: 1; }
.cta-link .cl-mascot { width: 52px; height: auto; display: block; }
.cta-link .cl-title { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.25; letter-spacing: -0.01em; }
.cta-link .cl-arrow { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1; }

.disclaimer {
  font-size: 10px; color: #a294bd; line-height: 1.7; margin-top: 12px;
}

.app-footer {
  text-align: center; padding: 6px 0 4px;
  font-size: 11px; color: #a294bd; font-weight: 500;
}

/* ── 데스크탑 반응형 (640px+) ── */
@media (min-width: 640px) {
  /* page: full-width */
  .page { width: 100%; padding: 0 0 80px; }

  /* 섹션: 화면 꽉 차는 밴드 */
  .card {
    background: #fff;
    border-radius: 0;
    box-shadow: none;
    margin-bottom: 0;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  }
  .card:last-of-type { border-bottom: none; }

  /* 섹션 내부 콘텐츠: 최대 900px 중앙 */
  .card-body {
    padding: 64px max(48px, calc(50% - 450px));
  }

  /* 히어로 내부 요소: 개별 중앙 정렬 */
  .hero-header {
    padding: 32px max(48px, calc(50% - 450px)) 0;
  }
  .hero-body {
    padding: 28px max(48px, calc(50% - 450px)) 14px;
  }
  .kpi-grid {
    padding: 0 max(48px, calc(50% - 450px)) 36px;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  }
  .hero-foot {
    padding: 0 max(48px, calc(50% - 450px)) 32px;
  }

  /* 챕터 카드의 로고 헤더도 동일 중앙 정렬 */
  .card > .hero-header {
    padding: 24px max(48px, calc(50% - 450px)) 0;
  }

  /* 데스크탑 폰트 확대 */
  .hero-title   { font-size: 46px; }
  .section-title { font-size: 30px; }

  /* KPI 가로 3열 배치 */
  .kpi { flex-direction: row; text-align: left; }
  .kpi .kpi-icon { width: 64px; height: 64px; }
  .kpi .value { font-size: 28px; }

  /* 수익 범위 그리드 */
  .rev-range { gap: 14px; }

  /* 비교 그리드 가로 배치 */
  .compare-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }

  /* 스텝 그리드 가로 */
  .steps-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="page">

  <!-- ── HERO ── -->
  <section class="card card-hero">
    <div class="hero-header">
      <div class="hero-logo">
        <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="옆커폰 로고">

        </h1>
      </div>

    <div class="kpi-grid">

          <div class="note">어떤 상권에서도 검증된 압도적인 전국 인프라</div>

        </div>
      </div>

          <div class="note">감이 아닌, 데이터로 수익을 만듭니다</div>
        </div>
        <div class="kpi-icon" aria-hidden="true">

        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="kpi">
        <div class="kpi-text">
          <div class="label">커뮤니티 잠재 고객</div>

          <div class="note">네이버 카페·유튜브 채널 구독자 규모</div>
        </div>
        <div class="kpi-icon" aria-hidden="true" style="display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:3px; padding:5px; width:56px; height:56px;">
          <img src="https://cdn.simpleicons.org/youtube/FF0000" alt="YouTube" style="width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:contain;">
          <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="네이버 카페" style="width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:contain;">
          <img src="https://cdn.simpleicons.org/instagram/E4405F" alt="Instagram" style="width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:contain;">
          <img src="https://cdn.simpleicons.org/kakaotalk/FEE500" alt="KakaoTalk" style="width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:contain;">
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="hero-foot">
      <div class="hf-divider"></div>

        <span class="hf-dot"></span>
      </p>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- ── CHAPTER 01 ── -->
  <section class="card">
    <div class="hero-header">
      <div class="hero-logo">
        <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="옆커폰 로고">
        <span class="wordmark"></span> <!--옆커폰 창업 가이드북 넣는 곳곳--> 
      </div>

            <li><span class="tp-icn pos">✓</span>재고 0원 · 위탁 판매</li>
            <li><span class="tp-icn pos">✓</span>본사 마케팅 지원</li>

      </div>

      <div class="trend-donut">
        <div class="donut-section">
          <div class="donut-wrap">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 200 200" class="donut-svg">
              <circle cx="100" cy="100" r="80" fill="none" stroke="#F0E8FA" stroke-width="30"/>

              <circle cx="100" cy="100" r="80" fill="none" stroke="#A08BD0" stroke-width="30"

              <circle cx="100" cy="100" r="80" fill="none" stroke="#D86C9E" stroke-width="30"
                class="donut-seg" data-dash="100.5" stroke-dasharray="0 502.4" stroke-dashoffset="-401.9" transform="rotate(-90 100 100)"/>
            </svg>
            <div class="donut-center">
              <div class="lbl">수익 분산 구조</div>
              <div class="big">3-way</div>
            </div>

          <div class="legend">
            <div class="row">
              <div class="left"><span class="sw" style="background:#6034A7;"></span><div><div class="name">판매 수수료</div><div class="desc">휴대폰 판매 · 기기 수당</div></div></div>

          <img class="cl-mascot" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="커퐁이">
          <div class="cl-title">홈페이지<br>바로가기</div>
          <div class="cl-arrow">→</div>

      <div class="disclaimer">
        ※ 본 자료에 기재된 수익·실적·지표는 2026년 4월 기준 전국 가맹점 평균 및 대표 사례를 바탕으로 작성되었으며, 개별 매장 여건(입지·운영·시기)에 따라 차이가 발생할 수 있습니다. 가맹비·교육비 할인 혜택은 1000호점까지 한정 지원됩니다.

  <div class="app-footer">옆커폰 창업 가이드북 · 2026</div>
</div>

<script>
(function () {
  const DURATION = 1800;
  function easeOutQuart(t) { return 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 4); }
  function fmt(val, decimals, format) {
    if (decimals != null) return val.toFixed(parseInt(decimals, 10));
    const r = Math.round(val);
    return format === 'comma' ? r.toLocaleString('ko-KR') : String(r);
  }
  function animateCount(el) {
    if (el.dataset.animated) return;
    el.dataset.animated = '1';
    const target = parseFloat(el.dataset.count);
    const decimals = el.dataset.decimals || null;
    const format = el.dataset.format || null;
    const bounceTarget = el.dataset.bounceTarget || null;
    const start = performance.now();
    (function tick(now) {
      const p = Math.min((now - start) / DURATION, 1);
      el.textContent = fmt(target * easeOutQuart(p), decimals, format);
      if (p < 1) {
        requestAnimationFrame(tick);
      } else if (bounceTarget) {
        const targetEl = el.closest('.' + bounceTarget);
        if (targetEl) targetEl.classList.add('count-bounce');
      }
    })(start);
  }
  function animateDonut(el) {
    if (el.dataset.animated) return;
    el.dataset.animated = '1';
    const dash = parseFloat(el.dataset.dash);
    const total = 502.4;
    const start = performance.now();
    (function tick(now) {
      const p = Math.min((now - start) / DURATION, 1);
      el.setAttribute('stroke-dasharray', (dash * easeOutQuart(p)) + ' ' + total);
      if (p < 1) requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    })(start);
  }

  const io = new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
    entries.forEach(e => {
      if (!e.isIntersecting) return;
      if (e.target.classList.contains('count')) animateCount(e.target);
    });
  }, { threshold: 0.15 });

  document.querySelectorAll('.count[data-count]').forEach(el => io.observe(el));

  // 라인 차트: CSS 애니메이션 트리거
  const trendChart = document.querySelector('.trend-chart');
  if (trendChart) {
    new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
      if (!entries[0].isIntersecting) return;
      entries[0].target.classList.add('is-visible');
    }, { threshold: 0.2 }).observe(trendChart);
  }

  // 카드 스크롤 양방향 토글
  const trendPointsEl = document.querySelector('.trend-points');
  if (trendPointsEl) {
    const badItems = Array.from(trendPointsEl.querySelectorAll('.tp-item:not(.tp-hi)'));
    const goodItem = trendPointsEl.querySelector('.tp-hi');
    let dimsLocked = false;
    let isCollapsed = false;

    function lockDimensions() {
      if (dimsLocked) return;
      badItems.forEach(el => {
        el.style.width  = el.offsetWidth  + 'px';
        el.style.height = el.offsetHeight + 'px';
        el.style.flex   = '0 0 auto';
      });
      dimsLocked = true;
    }

    function collapseCards() {
      if (isCollapsed) return;
      lockDimensions();
      isCollapsed = true;
      badItems.forEach((el, i) => {
        setTimeout(() => el.classList.add('tp-collapsed'), i * 150);
      });
      if (goodItem) goodItem.classList.add('tp-expanded');
      // 요식업·편의점이 접힌 뒤 도넛차트 등장 + 세그먼트 그리기 애니메이션
      const donutEl = document.querySelector('.trend-donut');
      if (donutEl) {
        setTimeout(() => {
          donutEl.classList.add('donut-visible');
          donutEl.querySelectorAll('.donut-seg').forEach(seg => animateDonut(seg));
        }, badItems.length * 150 + 200);
      }
    }

    function restoreCards() {
      if (!isCollapsed) return;
      isCollapsed = false;
      badItems.forEach(el => el.classList.remove('tp-collapsed'));
      if (goodItem) goodItem.classList.remove('tp-expanded');
      const donutEl = document.querySelector('.trend-donut');
      if (donutEl) donutEl.classList.remove('donut-visible');
    }

    function checkCardScroll() {
      const rect = trendPointsEl.getBoundingClientRect();
      const viewH = window.innerHeight;
      // 카드 상단이 뷰포트 35% 위로 → collapse
      // 카드 상단이 뷰포트 55% 아래로 → restore (hysteresis)
      if (!isCollapsed && rect.top < viewH * 0.35) collapseCards();
      else if (isCollapsed && rect.top > viewH * 0.55) restoreCards();
    }

    window.addEventListener('scroll', checkCardScroll, { passive: true });
    checkCardScroll();
  }

  // Cost chart bar animation (staggered)
  const chartEl = document.querySelector('.cost-chart');
  if (chartEl) {
    new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
      if (!entries[0].isIntersecting) return;
      chartEl.querySelectorAll('.cc-bar[data-w]').forEach((bar, i) => {
        setTimeout(() => { bar.style.width = bar.dataset.w + '%'; }, i * 220);
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.4 }).observe(chartEl);
  }

  // KPI 아이콘 박스 등장 애니메이션 (스태거 팝)
  const kpiGrid = document.querySelector('.kpi-grid');
  if (kpiGrid) {
    new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
      if (!entries[0].isIntersecting) return;
      kpiGrid.querySelectorAll('.kpi-icon').forEach((icon, i) => {
        setTimeout(() => icon.classList.add('icon-in'), i * 160);
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.2 }).observe(kpiGrid);
  }

  // Steps grid staggered entrance (fade-up + badge pop)
  const stepsGrid = document.querySelector('.steps-grid');
  if (stepsGrid) {
    new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
      if (!entries[0].isIntersecting) return;
      stepsGrid.querySelectorAll('.step').forEach((step, i) => {
        setTimeout(() => step.classList.add('step-in'), i * 460);
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.1 }).observe(stepsGrid);
  }
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
